title: Vektor plugin registry index
description: index.json, as vektor-registry build writes it and Vektor reads it (design §6). Each file under plugins/ is one element of 'plugins'. New fields never bump schemaVersion; unknown fields are ignored. Vektor accepts the index only if index.json.sig (Ed25519, base64 of 64 bytes, over the exact bytes of index.json) verifies.

generated.description: When vektor-registry build made this file.

revoked.description: Versions that must not be installed and are turned off where installed.

https.description: Always https. (Only the local test registry may use http://127.0.0.1.)

id.description: Reverse domain, lowercase. The file is plugins/<id>.json.

summary.description: One or two lines, shown on the card.

description.description: Shown when there is no readme.

categories.description: Become the chips of Get Plugins.

icon.description: A PNG or SVG, at most 512 KB.

permissions.description: Exactly the manifest's permissions; the pull-request check compares them.

images.description: The only remote images the readme may show. An image the readme uses that is not listed here is not loaded.

api.description: The plugin API the plugin was written for.

minVektor.description: The oldest Vektor that runs it.

url.description: The package: a zip of the plugin folder, hosted by the author (a release asset).

sha256.description: Of the package, lowercase hex. Vektor installs the package only if it matches.

reason.description: Plain words; shown to the user.
